This plot is less than one timad, but I grow sorghum here every year because it survives drought better than teff. I will apply a small amount of DAP at planting — the extension man said it should be around ten kilograms of nitrogen for each hectare — since I bought two bags for my whole farm and I am sharing them across plots. I will also spread manure from my oxen, as I do every season on this owned land, and I am using my own saved seed because the cooperative seed costs too much. My family will work about thirty days weeding and chasing birds, and I will not hire anyone because the plot is too small for that.
